coverage_gaps: Bulgaria (JUR-0026): regulator is the National Revenue Agency (Gambling Act); no official URL confirmed.
France (JUR-0018): regulator is ANJ; online poker and betting are licensed, casino games online are not; no official URL confirmed.
Panama (JUR-0047): regulated by the Junta de Control de Juegos under the Ministry of Economy and Finance; online licensing reported; no official URL seen (only a legal dictionary and trade sites).

Albania (JUR-0030): 2019 ban on online and sports betting lifted by Law 18/2024 for online sports betting only; regulatory package completed mid-2026; as of Aug 2026 no licences issued; no online casino framework (trade press). No official URL seen.
Monaco (JUR-0063): state monopoly (SBM) under Law 1.103 of 1987; no online licensing framework; Bill 722 pending (trade press). Regulator is the Service de Contrôle des Jeux; no official URL seen.

Cambodia (JUR-0025): licensed land-based casinos under the Law on Management of Commercial Gambling; online gambling banned (no licences since 2019); CGMC enforcing from Oct 2026; draft Suppression of Illegal Gambling law under review (trade press). No official URL seen.

Labels likely outdated or needing a decision: Brazil, Philippines, UAE, Australia, Singapore, Bulgaria, Lithuania, Georgia, Hungary, Cyprus, France, Kenya, South Africa, Panama, Albania (prospective), North Macedonia (state monopoly), Monaco (monopoly), Cambodia (land-based only).
